what: Planned driver does not explicitly export SESSION_ID and ISSUE_NUMBER before calling render-final-summary.sh
scenario_or_breakage: render-final-summary.sh reads SESSION_ID and ISSUE_NUMBER from environment, so a direct driver run or stale/missing sourced env can render runid=unknown, omit or mis-target the summary upsert, or make the empty-SESSION_ID path inherit stale state
suggested_fix: Inside design-publish.sh, set and export SESSION_ID from --session-id and ISSUE_NUMBER from --issue before every render-final-summary.sh call; add a harness assertion that the stub sees those env values

what: Plan omits the current unexpected publish-failure branch when design-log-publish.sh exits nonzero without PUBLISH_OK
scenario_or_breakage: An early shell/tool crash can leave PUBLISH_OK empty, skip rename, and avoid appending the captured failure log, reducing recovery visibility compared with the current Step 5c contract
suggested_fix: Preserve the existing branch: when publish rc is nonzero and no PUBLISH_OK line was parsed, treat it as PUBLISH_OK=false, append design-log-publish.failure.log under Warnings with the rc, and keep rename skipped
